thought.text: All validation checks are complete. Here is my assessment.

reasoning_content:
All checks pass. Let me summarize. One more: verify node_modules present and example deps, and that npm ls example is consistent.

I have enough evidence. Let me also cleanup /tmp loader (not in workspace, fine).

Final assessment: success.

Evidence list:
- Node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0 present.
- /workspace/node_modules present, npm ls root exit 0 with all deps.
- dist build artifacts exist, match package.json entry points (dist/formulardesigner.es.js, dist/src/index.d.ts, dist/src/types/index.d.ts).
- ESM import works, exports FormularDesigner function; SSR render produces markup (5648 chars) with KERN classes.
- Example app: node_modules linked via file:..; dev server starts on 5173, root 200, all src modules transform 200, library bundle and its dep graph resolve 200.
- Production build exists and preview serves 200 for html/js/css.
- API getModel/setDirtyForm defined in types and bundle.

Limitations: Playwright E2E (npm run test) cannot run because browsers not installed — but that's not required by the guide; guide's validation is the example app. Installing browsers is out of bounds. That does not establish failure.

Note the guide's npm install of the published package isn't tested but registry confirms 1.0.2 exists and repo package.json matches.

action.message:
Validation complete: the Formulardesigner installation is complete and operational according to the supplied guide.

Key checks performed (all in-container, no repairs/dependency installs):
- Runtime present: node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0.
- Library install: `/workspace/node_modules` exists; `npm ls --depth=0` exits 0 with all declared deps resolved.
- Library build artifacts present and matching `package.json` entry points: `dist/formulardesigner.es.js` (965 kB), `dist/src/index.d.ts`, `dist/src/types/index.d.ts`, `dist/assets/index.css`. Bundle exports `FormularDesigner`; `getModel`/`setDirtyForm` (the documented ref API) are present.
- Runtime behavior: loading the built ESM bundle in Node (CSS stubbed via a temporary external loader) yields export `FormularDesigner` (function); server-rendering it with the guide's empty form produced 5.6 KB of valid KERN markup — evidence the component actually executes.
- Example app (the guide's primary run path): `example/node_modules/@seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner` is a valid symlink to the repo root (`file:..`); `npm run dev` served `http://localhost:5173` with HTTP 200; every `example/src` module transformed 200 and the full dependency graph (React, zustand, react-hook-form, use-sync-external-store, and the library bundle/CSS) resolved 200 with no Vite pre-transform errors.
- Production build serves: `vite preview` returned 200 for the built HTML/JS/CSS.
- Published-package path sanity check: npm registry confirms `@seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner@1.0.2` (matching the repo version) exists.
- Temporary servers were stopped; ports 5173/4173 confirmed free. A `test-results/` dir created by my Playwright attempt was removed.

Limitation (does not indicate failure): `npm run test` (Playwright E2E) cannot execute because browser binaries are not installed, and installing them is outside the validation boundaries. This is not part of the documented install/run workflow, so it does not affect the outcome.
